build_CoefficientMapping: build a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic degree l and order m coefficients for SO(3) representations
create_CoefficientMapping_coefficient_id: create a coefficient index mask for spherical harmonics with a given maximum degree l and order m
build_SO3_Grid: build an SO3 grid module to transform irreps to and from a 2D spherical grid using e3nn
create_SO3_Grid_to_grid: create a grid representation from an irreps embedding tensor using the SO3 grid transformation matrices
create_SO3_Grid_from_grid: create an irreps representation from a 2D spherical grid tensor using the SO3 grid inverse transformation
